name: Zenra Laura Run ~Haikyo kara no Dasshutsu~
original_name: 全裸・ローラ・ラン ～廃墟からの脱出～
source: Our heroine with no name has woken up with no memories in a classroom with no clothing. Sneaking around the school grounds at night wearing nothing but cat ears and a ribbon around her neck she's afraid of being naked in such a public place when she stumbles upon a murder. Without any clothing can she escape to freedom?
